verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a documented Core API with HTTP Basic Auth, SDKs, sandbox testing, and explicit endpoints to create DNS records (create-record) and list them (list-records), which supports programmatic automation. However, the evidence pack contains no documented update or delete DNS record endpoints, nor any explicit mention of ACME/TXT challenge workflows, leaving the full CRUD lifecycle only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: documented update-record and delete-record endpoints, explicit ACME/TXT-challenge automation example or guide.
